instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Forge Capital is an Insurtech MGA specializing in parametric weather insurance for smallholder farmers, blending data science with risk modeling. The company operates across Portugal and Spain, managing 5,000 policies using automated satellite data feeds to trigger payouts based on predefined environmental events. While highly effective in its niche, the current operational structure relies heavily on manual processes due to a lack of formal middle management.
answers.pastInitiatives: We piloted a cloud-based project management tool last year, but adoption was inconsistent across teams and we ultimately reverted to spreadsheets and email for most project tracking. The experience highlighted that tool adoption requires more structured change management than we initially planned for.
answers.strategicGoals: A major international competitor has signaled intent to enter our core market within the next 12 months, making competitive moats critical for survival. We aim to solidify our position by either achieving superior actuarial accuracy or developing a unique risk aggregation model that is prohibitively expensive and time-consuming for new entrants to replicate.
answers.additionalContext: The team is currently highly focused on maintaining existing policy uptime and meeting compliance requirements, leaving minimal bandwidth for proactive innovation.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

opportunities.title: Automated Risk Aggregation Engine (Incremental)
opportunities.rationale: Developing a proprietary machine learning model that aggregates risk data from multiple small-scale insurance sources could increase underwriting accuracy and efficiency. This leverages existing satellite data capabilities without requiring fundamental system overhauls.

first_actions: Allocate 20% of Q3 engineering sprint capacity to feature development for the risk model.
Define key performance indicators (KPIs) for model precision improvement.
resources_needed: Software licensing for advanced ML tooling ($15k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase underwriting prediction accuracy by 5% within 6 months.
milestones: Month 3: Baseline model implementation and data pipeline stabilization.
Month 6: Pilot results demonstrating a 5% improvement in premium forecasting.

opportunities.title: Hyper-Localized Micro-Insurance Platform (Bold)
opportunities.rationale: Instead of competing broadly, Forge Capital could build a highly granular micro-insurance platform tailored specifically for hyper-local environmental events. This radical approach minimizes regulatory friction in specific regions and creates an impenetrable data moat that competitors cannot easily copy.

first_actions: Conduct market research on three underserved micro-climates (e.g., specific high-altitude areas).
Identify legal frameworks for specialized localized product structuring.
execution_plan.success_metric: Launch and achieve 1,000 policies in the first hyper-localized segment within 9 months.
milestones: Month 4: Final product specification and regulatory blueprint.
Month 9: Launch of MVP for one specific micro-climate.

next_steps.action: Conduct a formal 'Innovation Time' allocation via budget reallocation to prevent operational demands from completely stifling innovation.
Establish a lightweight, cross-functional 'Innovation Working Group' (2 people) focused solely on radical market defense strategies for the next 6 months.

key_weaknesses: High dependency on key owner-level expertise, leading to single points of failure and limited scalability.
Informal innovation process resulting in inconsistent adoption of tools and project tracking methods.
Limited digital maturity (2/10), making the transition from manual spreadsheets to automated data science challenging without external support.
Current team size is insufficient for both maintaining compliance and aggressive long-term market defense initiatives simultaneously.
